title: 单手刺击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：下，左，右。用剑单手直刺对方的面部
second_page: 单手刺击，伤害略低，但是容易命中且直击要害，属于出其不意的打法，在长剑上效果更佳

en_us.title: Single handed thrust
en_us.first_page: Input: down, left, and right. use the sword to stab the enemy in the face
en_us.second_page: although the damage was a bit low, but a hit on the face will make do for it, it was easy to use and easy to hit
